summary: Unauthenticated network-exposed shell PTY bound to all interfaces
details: elephant-tusk-runner starts an Express + WebSocket server that binds on 0.0.0.0 with wide-open CORS (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *) and exposes multiple paths that pipe network-supplied bytes directly into a spawned bash/powershell PTY inheriting process.env and process.cwd(). server.js attaches a WebSocket route /terminal-stream where ws.on('message') writes msg.data into ptySession.write, and terminal-server.js does the same on /api/v1/pty-terminal-socket via pty.spawn + ws.on('message') → ptyProcess.write(packet.data). An HTTP endpoint POST /api/v1/workspace-terminal-command additionally accepts a JSON body and executes liveTerminalShellPointer.write(stdinStringValue + '\r') against a lazily spawned PTY. There is no authentication, no origin check, and the listener binds to all interfaces, so any network- or browser-reachable party obtains full-shell RCE on the host running the tool.
